# Accesco Living

> India's first intelligent circular commerce ecosystem — delivering fresh groceries via Grokly, food via Swadishtt, and instant fashion via InstaStyle. One app. One cart. One ecosystem that learns how your household lives.

Accesco Living Private Limited is a Bengaluru-based, pre-launch consumer commerce startup (ISO 9001:2015 certified) with 20+ team members. We are building a unified intelligent ecosystem that powers daily household commerce across groceries, food delivery, and fashion.

## Our Ventures

- **Grokly**: Fresh grocery and daily essentials delivery sourced directly from Karnataka farms via FarmChain. Includes LocalMeds (pharmacy and health delivery).
- **Swadishtt**: Food delivery and cloud kitchen platform powered by Swadishtt Cafe micro-kitchens. Includes DineX (smart dining reservations and events).
- **InstaStyle**: Instant fashion delivery in 15–20 minutes with trial-at-doorstep, virtual try-on, thrift marketplace, and Reverse Fashion Loop.

## Key Differentiators

- **FarmChain**: Direct sourcing network removing 6 middlemen between Karnataka farms and Bengaluru households. Farmers earn 2–3x mandi prices.
- **Household Intelligence Layer**: Learns household behaviour over 30–60 days, reaching 85% prediction accuracy on weekly grocery needs.
- **Budget-First Commerce**: Every product tagged in real time against household budget.
- **Reverse Commerce Loop**: Packaging collected, carbon credits earned, organic waste returned to farms as compost.

## Company Info

- Founded: 2025
- HQ: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- Certification: ISO 9001:2015
- Stage: Pre-launch, Beta launching March 2026
- Fundraising: Pre-seed, seeking Rs 1.5–2 crore
